Steps.Text: Hi there! can you hear me?
Thanks for volunteering as a Search & Rescue Operator!
We're going to take you through a little training exercise here, okay?
Let's walk forward. Use the 'W' key to move forward
Great! Now to move back, use the 'S' key
Excellent, now to move left, use the 'A' key
And to move right, use the 'D' key
Remember to open your map to find your bearings. Use the 'E' key to open your map
Good job! Use the mouse to also move your view while exploring
Now, do you see your little furry friend beside you? He shall be your guide
He has a keen sense of smell, and will be able to help direct you towards our missing person if he picks up the scent!
If he detects something, he'll run out in front of you giving you a range of directions he thinks they might be in!
After that, it's up to you to pick a direction and start exploring. Keep using the dog to help hone in on our missing person!
If the dog smells nothing, then keep exploring until he picks something up
Right, lets get searching! To tell the dog to search, press the 'T' key
Excellent! He's picked up something. Time to get searching!
